meta.name: migrate-from-v1
meta.description: Finish migrating a NanoClaw v1 install into v2. Run after `bash migrate-v2.sh` completes. Seeds the owner, migrates legacy memory, reconciles container configs, and helps port custom v1 code. Triggers on "migrate from v1", "finish migration", "v1 migration".

copy.tagline: 完成 NanoClaw v1 到 v2 的迁移
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在将 NanoClaw v1 升级到 v2
copy.tagline_en: Finish migrating NanoClaw from v1 to v2
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are upgrading NanoClaw from v1 to v2

howto.what: 完成 NanoClaw 从 v1 到 v2 的收尾迁移。先确认 `migrate-v2.sh` 已跑完,再设置管理员、迁移旧记忆、核对容器配置。最后检查一切正常并重启服务。
howto.when: 当你说到 “migrate from v1”“finish migration”“v1 migration” 触发词时;或在 `bash migrate-v2.sh` 跑完后要求收尾时使用。

say.text: 帮我把 NanoClaw 从 v1 迁移到 v2。
say.note: Claude 会先检查迁移脚本是否已跑完,再开始收尾。

say.text: 迁移脚本已经跑完了,继续收尾吧。
say.note: Claude 会读取交接文件,先设置管理员并迁移旧记忆。
触发「finish migration」,开始收尾流程。

howto.what_en: Completes the NanoClaw v1→v2 migration wrap-up: verifies the script ran, then seeds the owner, migrates legacy memory, and reconciles container configs. Finally checks that everything works and restarts the service.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'migrate from v1', 'finish migration', or 'v1 migration'; also after 'bash migrate-v2.sh' has completed, when you ask to wrap up the migration.

say_en.text: Help me migrate NanoClaw from v1 to v2.
say_en.note: Checks the migration script, then starts the wrap-up.

say_en.text: The migration script has finished — continue the wrap-up.
say_en.note: Reads the handoff, seeds the owner, migrates memory.
